label: Department status review

label: Captain's log and standing orders

label: Approve approach and sensor power

label: Review trial results with heads

note: Bench-test kind; live aiming, group measurement and zero-screw adjustment at the range are not represented.

note: Screen-based power game; the real work is physical breaker and feed setting at the cargo junction against a placard.

label: Coolant loop cross-check

label: Watch core temps at high output
note: Trend graph; the real work is physically watching the core gauge and housing at the warp core.

label: Security status to XO
note: A form lets the player fill fields, but the real work is briefing the XO aloud, choosing what matters and reading back orders.

label: Run baseline scans on duty crew on request
note: The ward activity is bedside monitoring; a baseline scan is a handheld sweep over a standing crew member, which that activity does not give.

label: Screen away-team members on return
note: The ward activity is bedside monitoring; screening returning people needs a handheld sweep over each person, which that activity does not provide.

label: Prepare for lifting injuries and strains
note: Tray arrangement covers laying items out, but not setting bed height or matching a support to a strain versus a fracture, which this job needs.

label: Run rapid scans and bloodwork for the doctor
note: Vitals reads bedside monitor numbers; this job is drawing blood and running the analyser, which the vitals activity does not cover.

label: Move stable patients to recovery and chart handoff
note: A form covers the charting but not the unclipping, lifting and wheeling of a patient, which is most of this job.

label: Check medical hologram matrix
note: Calibration covers a single dial; the emitter self-test, version check and fault log that make up this job have no matching activity.

label: Wellness walk to quarters
note: Counselling is a talk-based exchange; the wellness walk is mostly walking doors and reading moods on the way, which a talk does not cover.

label: Screen returning survey team
note: The ward activity is bedside monitoring; screening a returning team is a walk-past reading and symptom check, which the bedside activity does not provide.

label: Treat crush and strain injuries from cargo bay
note: Dosing covers medicine only; treating a crush injury means examining the limb and splinting it, which the dose activity does not include.

label: Stage trauma kit near bridge-deck lift
note: Restock is shelving stock; staging a trauma kit by the lift means carrying it, checking its contents and testing the bag valve, which that activity does not cover.

label: Check galley replicator base stock and feed lines
note: Fresh is an expiry-date sort; the real job is reading a gauge, swapping a cartridge and tracing feed lines by hand.

label: Check cold store and dry stores
note: Only the date-expiry part mirrors the work; temperature reading and crate counting are not modelled.

label: Stock check and shopping list for the Galley Chief
note: Writing the shopping list and checking pending orders are missing; the game only sorts dates.

label: Make extra water and broth in bulk
note: Batch volume, purity gauge and cooling are not modelled; the cook game covers one plate at a time.
why: the broth theme of the range is the bulk batch; purity and cooling are not modelled

label: Plan, cook and serve a meal
note: Menu planning, briefing the cook and reading the queue are missing; the cook game only covers the hands-on cooking.
why: cooking the meal on the range is the hands-on core; planning is the galley chief's other jobs

label: Prepare special-diet and soft-food trays
note: Reading diet cards and checking food texture by hand are missing; the cook game does not model dietary rules.
why: the patient-diet theme cooks the soft-food dishes; diet cards are the menu it draws from

label: Keep the mess open through drills
note: Running the room and the line under drill pressure is not modelled; the cook game only tests one meal.

label: Reset a booked session
note: Clearing the room and walking through the booking is missing; the calibrate game is a dial-tuning task.

label: Open bookings and run the standard grid sweep
note: The physical emitter and grid sweep is missing; the schedule game covers only the bookings.

label: Run a calm relaxation program for off-shift survey crew
note: Previewing and matching a program to a crew request is missing; the calibrate game is a dial-tuning task.

label: Help the cargo handlers stack crates in the playroom
note: Lifting and aligning physical crates is missing; the load-balance game abstracts the stacking.

label: Switch grid emitters to a calm recovery program for patients' families
note: Previewing and matching a program to a family card is missing; the calibrate game is a dial-tuning task.

label: Stand by with the grid in case the medical hologram needs emitter help
note: The job is standing by and reacting to a call; the power game is a timed draw-limit task with no waiting on a channel.

label: Cycle the emitters through every program class
note: Walking the emitters to check glow and tone is missing; the calibrate game is a dial-tuning task.

label: Audit food and spares stores
note: fresh is a generic console screen; a shelf-by-shelf physical count against a ledger does not come through.

label: Replicator feedstock and queue
note: fresh does not involve reading job tags, reseating cartridges or topping up gauges.

label: Requisition round
note: manifest matching does not cover checking signatures or the hand-over.

label: Issue probes and sample containers to science
note: manifest matching does not cover calibration tags or handing a tray to an officer.

label: Clear space and verify the cargo manifest
note: the manifest check fits, but clearing the transporter path is missing.
why: the manifest check is the stated job; clearing the path is the cargo handlers' "Clear the way"

label: Seal hazmat and secure cargo
note: lash is strap tensioning; threading a seal wire and crimping a hazmat lid is a different hand action.

label: Draw medical supplies and bedding to sickbay
note: clearout is about removing items; drawing and loading stock is a carry-and-check job.

label: Verify spares kits against the stress-test plan
note: manifest matching does not cover checking spec tags against the stress plan or testing physical fit.

label: Routine pattern checks on all food units
note: bench is a workbench-style test; routine checks are a walked round of units.

label: Stores count and refill
note: a tally fits the count, but refilling hoppers by drop is the real job and is missing.

label: Extra rations for long lab shifts
note: fresh does not involve roster counts or matching the nutrition tags.

label: Print medical consumables and sterile packs
note: sequence covers printing but not the sterility indicator check and the seal press.
why: keying the print pattern is the print; the seal press is a step of it

label: Spare parts printed for engineering
note: sequence is a generic print-then-wait; spare parts need a fit check against the engineer's gauge.
